'''TK-32028''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[human]] [[coastal defender stormtrooper]] [[captain]] who was part of the [[Scarif Deployment]].<ref name="UVG" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> TK-32028 was part of the coastal troops stationed on [[Scarif]] to protect the citadel.<ref name="UVG" /> When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] infiltrated the Scarif facility, TK-32028 and the Imperial garrison fought in vain to prevent the [[Death Star plans]] from being stolen.<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
